basic_profile.bio: I'm a 25-year-old cybersecurity enthusiast hailing from Austin, Texas. By day, I work as a junior security analyst, and by night, I dive deep into the world of gaming and tech. My recent obsession is with 'Hades', which I can't stop playing since discovering it. When I'm not gaming, you can find me exploring the latest in security tech or binge-watching my favorite shows, like 'The Last Airbender'. Single and loving the extra time to indulge in my hobbies. Typically online in the evenings and on weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise lies in cybersecurity, having pursued a bachelor's degree in Computer Science. I constantly update myself through online courses and community forums, particularly in defensive security strategies. My gaming knowledge is mostly self-taught, fueled by countless hours of play and community interaction.
